verdicts.reason: A is scattered: URL far left, headline crammed in the middle with tiny blank swatches, photos shrunk to thumbnails, 'RESTAURANT' separated from 'Cascadia', and a stray pattern tile and divider. Nothing reads as a group and the hero photos are lost. B has a left-to-right order (headline, divider, photos, frame, plate, brand and URL block) with the brand text grouped and legible. But the photos are tiny, there are empty beige and white panels, and the headline is cramped at the left edge. Both are unusable, B less so.
